svg.title: rEach and Teach: trust boundaries
svg.desc: The student's computer, the private course server, the AI provider and GitHub are separate zones. Six numbered crossings show what moves between them and how each is protected.
svg.text: Four zones, six crossings. Everything between the computer and the course server is signed, sealed or both.
The assistant the student already uses.
rEach's hooks sit on every prompt,
Install key: made here, never leaves
Owned files: the agent may write
course server · private to the instructors
sees the chat, as with any assistant
Each request carries a signature from the install's own RSA-4096 key
and a digest of the computer's fingerprint.
AES-256-GCM, with the key wrapped for this one install. Verified
before a single byte is unpacked.
Owned files and a manifest, sealed to the course server's key, and
only after the student says yes.
Proof of what arrived and when. rEach verifies each receipt before
Goes to the student's AI provider, as any chat does. rEach records
none of it and sends none of it.
rEach comes from public GitHub releases. The runtime kit is verified
against a manifest pinned in rEach.
